name: STR
desc: Strength measures bodily power, athletic training, and the extent to which you can exert raw physical force.

A Strength check can model any attempt to lift, push, pull, or break something, to force your body through a space, or to otherwise apply brute force to a situation. The Athletics skill reflects aptitude in certain kinds of Strength checks.
content: Strength (STR) measures bodily power, athletic training, and the ability to exert raw physical force. A Strength check can simulate lifting, pushing, pulling, or breaking objects, forcing your body through spaces, or applying brute force to situations. The Athletics skill reflects aptitude in certain Strength checks.

name: DEX
desc: Dexterity measures agility, reflexes, and balance.

A Dexterity check can model any attempt to move nimbly, quickly, or quietly, or to keep from falling on tricky footing. The Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, and Stealth skills reflect aptitude in certain kinds of Dexterity checks.
content: DEX (Dexterity) measures agility, reflexes, and balance. A Dexterity check can model any attempt to move nimbly, quickly, or quietly, or to keep from falling on tricky footing. The Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, and Stealth skills reflect aptitude in certain kinds of Dexterity checks.

name: CON
desc: Constitution measures health, stamina, and vital force.

Constitution checks are uncommon, and no skills apply to Constitution checks, because the endurance this ability represents is largely passive rather than involving a specific effort on the part of a character or monster.
content: Constitution (CON) measures health, stamina, and vital force. Constitution checks are uncommon, and no skills apply to Constitution checks, as the endurance this ability represents is largely passive rather than involving specific effort. This ability score is essential for endurance and resilience in characters and monsters.

name: INT
desc: Intelligence measures mental acuity, accuracy of recall, and the ability to reason.

An Intelligence check comes into play when you need to draw on logic, education, memory, or deductive reasoning. The Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, and Religion skills reflect aptitude in certain kinds of Intelligence checks.
content: INT (Intelligence) measures mental acuity, accuracy of recall, and the ability to reason. An Intelligence check is needed for logic, education, memory, or deductive reasoning, and is reflected in skills like Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, and Religion.

name: WIS
desc: Wisdom reflects how attuned you are to the world around you and represents perceptiveness and intuition.

A Wisdom check might reflect an effort to read body language, understand someone's feelings, notice things about the environment, or care for an injured person. The Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, and Survival skills reflect aptitude in certain kinds of Wisdom checks.
content: Wisdom (WIS) reflects perceptiveness and intuition, attuning you to the world around you. A Wisdom check involves reading body language, understanding feelings, noticing environmental details, or caring for the injured. Skills like Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, and Survival demonstrate aptitude in various Wisdom checks.

name: CHA
desc: Charisma measures your ability to interact effectively with others. It includes such factors as confidence and eloquence, and it can represent a charming or commanding personality.

A Charisma check might arise when you try to influence or entertain others, when you try to make an impression or tell a convincing lie, or when you are navigating a tricky social situation. The Deception, Intimidation, Performance, and Persuasion skills reflect aptitude in certain kinds of Charisma checks.
content: Charisma (CHA) is a crucial ability score that measures your interpersonal effectiveness, confidence, and eloquence. It reflects a charming or commanding personality, influencing interactions, persuasion, deception, intimidation, and performance. A Charisma check comes into play when trying to entertain, influence, make an impression, or navigate social situations. Skills like Deception, Intimidation, Performance, and Persuasion showcase aptitude in various Charisma checks, making it a vital attribute for successful social interactions.
